method.variant_order: All six forward/reverse rotations; pair directions balanced
method.scored_instrumentation: External wall clock and /usr/bin/time -l; no LPM timing tracing
method.candidate_admission: Every warm gate and scored response is up_to_date:true without counts
method.parity: Exact LPM lockfile bytes; distinct package-name/version inventory equality for baseline, candidate and Bun
method.limitations: Package inventory equality does not assert byte-by-byte Bun layout parity. Live seed resolution precedes scoring. No p99 claim.
